title: Inkingi ndende z’ibitandara bikubitwa n’umuyaga
intro: Iyumvire ubutekerezi buteye imbere bufise ingabire y’inkomezi zidasanzwe be n’ubuhinga butagira uko bungana bwo kwubaka. Ico kibano cari hagati y’ibitandara bininibinini kandi bigoramye, kikaba caradugije ibimenyetso bihambaye cane vyakora ku musozi. Yamara ubwibone bwarashinze imizi, kandi umuhamagaro wo gusubira gusenga Allah wenyene warashikiwe n’ugutera umugongo. Ivyakurikiyeho biguma ari imburi yatwawe n’umuyaga ubwawo.
clues: Twari ihanga rikomeye ryaje inyuma y’abantu ba Nuwa, duhezagiwe n’igihagararo kinini n’inkomezi nyinshi.
Twarubatse iminara miremire n’ibimenyetso ku kibanza cose co hejuru kugira ngo tugire imikino gusa n’ubwibone.
Twararata, tuvuga ngo ni nde aturusha ububasha mu nkomezi, kandi twakora ivy’ububisha ata mbabazi.
Twanse intumwa yacu Hud igihe yaduhamagara ngo dusenge Allah wenyene, akamwita umugoyagoya n’umubeshi.
Twaratwengeye iyo ngabisho, turamutera intege ngo aduzanire igihano yaduteye ubwoba nimba ari umunyakuri.
Twarasambuwe n’umuyaga w’uburake kandi w’ingumba amajoro indwi n’imisi umunani, dusigaye twaguye nk’ibiti vy’imisukoni vy’imyobo.

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful." (46:22)
